items.q: How long does custom jewellery take?
items.a: Typically 4–6 weeks from design approval. Rush timelines may be possible for simpler pieces — we confirm on WhatsApp.
Yes, included free for most custom orders. You approve the render before we start crafting.

items.q: Can I use my old gold jewellery?
items.a: Absolutely. We assess purity and weight, then apply exchange value toward your new design.

items.q: What if I don't like the design?
items.a: We revise the concept until you are satisfied before production begins.
Yes — collect in Nadiad or arrange insured delivery across Gujarat and India with tracking.

items.q: Is there a design consultation fee?
items.a: Free for orders above ₹50,000. For smaller pieces we share a quick estimate first.

items.q: What payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Card, UPI, bank transfer, and installment plans on eligible orders.
Yes — BIS hallmarking and gemstone certificates where applicable.
